title: Will this work for my skin type?
content:
Yes. While it's made for melanin-rich skin, it works on all skin types and tones.

If you deal with breakouts, clogged pores, oily skin or constant blemishes, this is built for you.

title: When will I see results?
content:
Most people start seeing fewer breakouts and calmer, clearer skin within the first two weeks of regular use. The deep-cleaning works fast on the surface, then over the following weeks fewer new pimples come through as your pores stay clear.

Acne built up over years won't vanish overnight, so the people who get the best results use it consistently and stick with it. That consistency is what keeps the breakouts from coming back.

title: How is this different to everything else?
content:
If acids, benzoyl peroxide and medicated washes left your skin dry, raw and breaking out worse, you're not alone. On melanin-rich skin, harsh products often trigger more than they clear.

This works with your skin, not against it. The natural plant ash lifts the dead skin and oil clogging your pores, then clears the bacteria that turns them into breakouts, so acne stops at the source. Shea butter keeps your skin balanced so it never dries out.

title: Is it safe for facial use?
content:
Absolutely.

Unlike traditional soap bars (which have a pH of 9–10 and can strip the skin), our formula is a syndet bar with a skin-friendly pH of 5, which matches the skin’s natural acid mantle (pH 4.5–5.5).

This means:

  • It won’t dry or strip your skin
  • It won’t cause irritation that leads to dark marks
  • It’s safe for melanin-rich and sensitive skin
  • It’s suitable for daily use on the face, underarms, and bikini line

title: It seems expensive?
content:
One bar lasts most people weeks, since you only need a small lather, so the cost per wash is low. And it replaces the cleansers, spot treatments and products you've been stacking and replacing to fight breakouts.

It's also backed by our 60 day money-back guarantee. If your skin doesn't get clearer, you get your money back, so there's no real risk in trying it.

title: How do I use it?
content:
Daily Use:
Wet your skin, lather the bar, and massage over dark spots using circular motions for 30-60 seconds. Rinse thoroughly and pat dry. Follow with moisturizer. Use on face, underarms, bikini line, or anywhere you have hyperpigmentation.

Sensitive skin? Start 2-3 times per week, then increase to daily as your skin adjusts.

What to expect:

  • First few days: Smoother texture, softer feel
  • Weeks 2-4: Visible fading of dark spots with consistent daily use
  • Ongoing: Prevents new dark spots, razor bumps, and ingrown hairs from forming

Each bar lasts 30 days with daily use.
